title: Reverse Linked List
statement:
Given the head of a singly linked list represented as an array of values, reverse the list and return its array representation.

You should implement the Linked List data structure in your code, populate it with the given values, reverse it, and print the resulting values.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N (number of nodes).
Line 2: N space-separated integers representing the node values.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers representing the reversed list on a single line.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
if n == 0:
    print()
else:
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    class ListNode:
        def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
            self.val = val
            self.next = next
    
    # Build the list
    head = ListNode(a[0])
    curr = head
    for i in range(1, n):
        curr.next = ListNode(a[i])
        curr = curr.next
